primaryWrittenSources.facts: Conservation and development report identifies Siwamokkhaphiman Throne Hall, Phutthaisawan Chapel, Issarawinitchai Audience Hall, the Phra Wiman residential group and the Issaretsaratchanuson range as surviving parts of the former Front Palace.
The museum moved to the Front Palace in 1887. The royal chapel and Red House survive on the site.
